hard_case: Before #8205, ripr read call_deletion and side_effect as exposed: assert_eq!(p.log, vec![9]) counted as an exact oracle for the push, though the test seeds log = vec![9], locks the owner, and never runs the push.

mutants.equivalence_review: not equivalent: an unlocked beat logs 2 after the seed, but the only test beats while locked

reasoning: locked_beat_keeps_seeded_log seeds log = vec![9] and sets locked = true, so beat() returns before the push and the log keeps the seeded value whatever the push does. An expectation that only restates the seeded collection cannot confirm a guarded push (#8205, extending #8051).
